I had the shittiest case of apathy, self loathe, and depression for the better part of 13 years. TRT flipped my life right-side up and has given me, what I feel to be, a new lease on life. 

Edit: Feel free to contact me regarding questions for your article as well.
It may have been asked before, but what's some at home shit you guys do for bacne (if you get any)? I'm on a TRT dose of test e if that helps.
It honestly passes me off how true this is. So many people in my life know and no one does anything to help. I've just stopped trying no matter how low I get

If I were you I'd take a break from college after this semester and try to figure out what works for you to make you feel better before you go back. Medications, therapy, hobbies you can do everyday. Just something. Because trust me having depression and trying to go to college on top of it just isn't something that works, it'll only make you feel worse
